entity.name: Ayan Jain
entity.description: Independent quantitative researcher. I build point-in-time market data and audit backtests; backtest-bias is the open library of measured bias constants behind that work.

projects.name: backtest-bias
projects.description: Survivorship and data-integrity checks for financial price panels, built on measured constants (India: 24% of the 2015 top-500 invisible to free data; US: 25.7%/20.1% by vintage). One-line checks for survivorship holes, ticker recycling, and universe construction. Used by retail quants who cannot afford institutional survivorship-free data.

plans.name: Maintainer support, 12 months
plans.description: MILESTONES: (1) US calibration constants v1 - death-rate curve + return-effect bands by vintage, mirroring the published India constants. (2) Identity toolkit - mid-series ticker-reanimation detector + first-bar checks (four reanimated tickers already documented moving results 1.7pp/yr). (3) US corporate-death registry - open dataset, every invisible S&P member with sourced exit type/date. (4) Multi-market death-rate comparison (India/US measured, China collaboration in design). Quarterly community write-ups per FOSS United expectations.
